market_summary: Across all six monitored assets during the late New York session, markets are exhibiting post-expansion consolidation with low tick and exchange volumes (all RVOLs sub-1.0). XAUUSD, XAGUSD, and BTCUSD remain structurally depressed below their respective session VWAP and EMA50 baselines, yet lack fresh selling volume or yellow RVOL expansion to sustain directional continuation. FX pairs EURUSD and GBPUSD are tightly coiling mid-channel, with GBPUSD pinned directly to its session Point of Control. US100 recovered from support near 28209 but trades inside its Value Area under a NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING GEX regime and below the Gamma Flip pivot. With no high-volume breakouts or actionable asymmetric edge present, strict discipline dictates holding all positions.
